fact: The compact signed at Maseru on 12 May 2022 states that the e-Register is currently limited to HIV and tuberculosis patients and funds its expansion into a national electronic medical record system covering all primary health care patients, linked to national identification documents, under a Digital Health Services Activity budgeted at USD 22,526,000 of MCC funding, with the Government to assume the operating and maintenance costs in the final years of the compact term.
title: Millennium Challenge Compact between the United States of America, acting through the Millennium Challenge Corporation, and the Kingdom of Lesotho, acting through the Ministry of Finance
